prompt: The image is a pencil sketch with light color wash depicting a bustling school science fair. On the left, a girl in pigtails leans eagerly over a table, her eyes wide with curiosity as she looks at a bubbling blue beaker. Next to her stands a boy in a striped shirt, holding a clipboard tightly against his chest while pointing at the experiment with his free hand. In the center, a teacher with glasses observes the pair, standing calmly with arms crossed behind her back. To the right of the teacher, a golden retriever sits patiently on the floor, its tail thumping softly against the leg of a display board. Beside the dog, a volunteer in a yellow vest hands a pamphlet to a parent wearing a denim jacket. The parent accepts the paper with a smile, looking down at the child next to them. This child, wearing a dinosaur costume, reaches out to touch a model volcano situated on a nearby table. Behind the volcano, a stack of textbooks rests precariously, leaning slightly to one side. Above the scene, hanging from the ceiling, is a large poster chart displaying solar system orbits. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the room. There is no fire or smoke rising from the volcano model. The girl in pigtails maintains her forward lean throughout the observation. The boy in the striped shirt keeps his pointer finger extended toward the glassware. The teacher remains stationary in her central position. The golden retriever stays seated without moving from its spot. The interaction between the volunteer and the parent involves the direct handing of printed material. The boy actively points at the scientific apparatus for the girl to see. The girl directs her gaze intently at the chemical reaction occurring within the beaker. The dog occupies the space directly next to the wooden display structure. The spatial arrangement places the students on the left, the authority figure in the center, and the supporting adults and animal on the right, creating a balanced narrative flow across the sketched environment.
